second_pass.sequence: Completed first draft, retained it separately and recorded its hash, then rechecked literature against that draft and corrected the proposal document.

checks_and_corrections.result: Six min/max fields in four taxa are null in normalization and zero locally. Expanded proposed corrections; no claim to have reconstructed the migration that caused the difference.
Confirmed species regressions including H. latitabundus, L. nuda and T. terreum. Corrected draft to acknowledge their existence while separating regional yield from daily probability.
Added 2025 evidence on herbaceous roots and plant effects; preserved the non-obligate-tree distinction.
Local R21 reference 4 links a different article. Documented correct Le Tacon reference without altering the source review.
Local R21 reference 9 gives incorrect journal metadata. Added correction proposal: Journal of Fungi 7, 102.
Retained distinction between culture growth, observed plot range, soil horizons/carbonates and fungus-induced pH change. No species-wide numeric exclusion limits approved.
Confirmed effective local UI store path and identical profile hashes; local profiles and catalog remained unchanged.

limitations: Local species syntheses were compared for the requested ecological fields; not every external reference cited in all 21 syntheses was retrieved or independently validated.
A supported local preference is not a universal ecological boundary.
Scientific proposals are not applied to operational profiles or runtime filters.

followup_user_decisions.precedence: Document sections 1 and 8 supersede earlier restrictive implementation proposals; original review evidence and second-pass audit retained.
decisions: Broadest usable windows for fruiting months, hosts/habitats, soil pH and altitude min/max per profile
Add pH min/max to species JSON and maintenance UI with persistence
No orientation requirements for any species in this phase; revisit if needed
Keep salmonicolor/quieticolor grouped with broad windows
Keep ecological profiles distinct from proposed Rovello prediction target

rovello_current_evidence.limitations: Raw counts are not eligible episodes. No taxonomic audit of historical Rovello entries or new HA real inspection. A display name does not demonstrate grouped training.

followup_user_decisions.scope: Documentation only; no operational JSON edits, code changes, jobs or deployment.

rovello_grouping_decision.choice: Preserve original observation species IDs and group eligible observations in derived training data for one Rovello prediction target.
rovello_grouping_decision.preserve: Original profiles, observation identities, media, references and existing model artifacts.
rovello_grouping_decision.future: Separate member models remain possible with more observations.
rovello_grouping_decision.pending: Implement versioned mapping, episode handling, dataset preparation and group model training/validation. No jobs launched by this documentation update.
